query:
UPDATE tickets SET
             status_id = $3,
             category = (SELECT category FROM board_statuses WHERE id = $3),
             resolved_at = CASE
               WHEN (SELECT category FROM board_statuses WHERE id = $3) = 'closed'
                 AND resolved_at IS NULL THEN now()
               ELSE resolved_at END,
             updated_at = now()
           WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2
